title: Faroo stPROS + five ERC-1967 custody proxies — unprivileged value path review
closed_reasons: BridgeVault pays only the registered vToken (stPROS); withdrawToken/withdrawTokenWrapped revert NotVTokenContract for a fresh EOA, emergencyWithdraw is onlyOwner
Oracle writes are NotSlp (reporter = RewardsVault) or NotVToken (canonical vToken); setTokenAmount is onlyOwner
SlpDistributor.distribute is onlyKeeper and only pays whitelisted SLPs
RewardsVault.notifyOracle and every SLP value function are WHITELIST_ROLE
Pharos staking claimReward/claimStake are keyed by msg.sender; withdrawStake is validator-owner only
stPROS.withdrawComplete iterates the caller's own records and returns 0 for a fresh EOA; the queue surplus is 0 wei
No stPROS market below NAV identified; minting at NAV makes a deposit/redeem round trip value-neutral
key_facts: All six proxies resolved: stPROS impl 0xfD59…, BridgeVault 0xa7d3…, SlpDistributor 0x05A2…, RewardsVault 0xe698…, SLP1 0xc3d0…, SLP2 0xd15e…
StPROS/BridgeVault/SlpDistributor runtime keccaks match faroo-xyz/stpros-contracts mainnet/v4 records exactly
SLP1 and SLP2 implementations are byte-identical (runtime keccak 0x48686658…fc0aa3)
T = 5,119,038.227419 PROS = current staked principal 5,062,185.797112 + pending unbond 56,632.430307 + distributor float 220.000000
getTotalBalance = queuedWithdrawal = 1,247,604.019831 PROS; fresh-withdrawal surplus 0 wei
Owner and proxy admin are a 24h OZ TimelockController 0xC30dB054…; guardian 0xa04698… is pause-only
Foundry 1.8 cannot fork Pharos public RPC (eth_getAccountInfo / block-object params); executable proof is a 25-probe eth_call suite
caveats: Point-in-time block 22,613,377; queue equality moves with claims and deposits
SLP #1/#2 and RewardsVault are EXTERNAL_DEPLOYED in the repo; source is present but bytecode is not matched to it (live gates probed instead)
JIT yield capture is E-U-conditional only: gross <= ~$545/report and net-negative at a 5% cost of capital
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Faroo stPROS: every value path is role/timelock gated, the queue is exactly funded with zero surplus, and the oracle NAV reconciles to staked principal + unbonding + float.
